title: The porter saw
rule: A porter on the platform bench watches it all and gives his partial account in captions; he cannot see into the cupboard.
declares: adds a witness (the porter); E4-E5 reported as he guesses them

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: masthead slip 'THE PORTER SAW / as told by the porter on the platform bench' and eight collage panels on the LoC sheet, every one seen from the platform side, from the porter's bench

NEW Daumier cuts from 'Un premier voyage en chemin de fer' (1846, CC0): the dozing gentleman's seated body (with cane) and sleeping head, and the wide-eyed top-hatted man's head, glued together as the PORTER; the sleeping head is swapped for the staring one when he starts to watch

page 12's Daumier collage kit reused: the bourgeois of 'Il est devenu pro-pri-e-taire !' (1846) as the AGENT behind the glass, the bonneted woman as the STRANGER, the CONCIERGE door as the SERVICE door; frame, bench, counter and clock case cut from the prints' own crayon tone

HANDMADE: the porter's cut-paper cap with a brass badge (over his top hat), the platform bench, the station front with pen clapboard lines, the ticket window and the wall pier that hides the cupboard corner; first-person porter's captions, pen-hand balloons with the four canon lines verbatim, borders

events.E0: P1: from the bench, the agent at his desk through the glass, memo slip; P2: 'up he got, all business'
events.E1: P3: the lady at the glass; question balloon
events.E2: P4: he looks up at the office clock (4:10); answer balloon tailed through the glass
events.E3: P5: thanks balloon; she goes off past the bench
events.E4: P6 (guessed): he walks off behind the wall pier; 'The cupboard's there, I reckon, but that's behind the wall from my bench'
events.E5: P7 (heard only): bare wall, the forgetting balloon from behind the pier; P8: 'Came out with nothing. The SERVICE door? Shut at a quarter past, shut at half past.' with the shut SERVICE door seen through the window's far end

substitutions: none: the four lines verbatim; the forgetting line is heard, not seen
beat: the witness wakes and the agent leaves his sight: the porter's dozing head is swapped for the staring head, then the agent slides along the glass behind the wall pier, then the forgetting line arrives from where the porter cannot see
beat_frames: b01: P1 only, the porter dozing
b02: P1, the head swapped: he watches
b03: + P2-P6, the agent at the near end of the P6 window
b04: the agent half way along
b05: the agent gone behind the pier
b06: + P7, bare wall, no balloon
b07: the forgetting balloon from behind the pier

self_check.witness_signals: masthead 'as told by the porter on the platform bench'; first caption 'I'm the porter here'; a capped, badged figure on a bench in the foreground of five panels; every caption first person
self_check.outcome: SERVICE door shut (caption and picture); the key is never seen, as the rule requires (he cannot see into the cupboard)
self_check.pending: independent blind reading not run by the maker
